snippet.title: Risky Roads - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
[WARNING: Either out of laziness or clear-as-day low-budget nature of many Nostra Games titles, the game uses AI generated images for the trophy icons. The game itself, however, doesn't use any AI generated content, thankfully.]

Running across the road is a very challenging task for a little chicken. Lots of very fast cars and unexpected obstacles. You need a good reaction to help this cute little guy.

Don't forget that he has friends and they also want to cross the road.

Developed by NOSTRA GAMES
Also released on PlayStation 5

#ps4 #playstation4 #theforeseenarcade #riskyroads #nostragames
